rationale: No package.json/pinned-Node-dependency precedent exists anywhere in the repo; jsdom/Playwright would be first-of-kind infra conflicting with the dependency-minimization policy. Manual verification on close is a well-established repo pattern for behavioral-testing gaps on generated-HTML artifacts (directly analogous precedent: ENH-1770).
rule: Scope automated interaction testing out; verify manually
alternatives_rejected: Option A: Adopt a browser/DOM interaction test harness (jsdom or Playwright) under scripts/tests/js/ — rejected: no existing Node dependency infra to extend, heavier lift than the gap warrants.
